You trace fine lines of blue light above the injury, drawing the broken pattern together as a matching ache runs through your own hand.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One visible willing creature within 3 squares, including self.
Duration
Healing is immediate; the Strong Boon ends when used or at the end of the recipient’s next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and HP cost each time.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Pay 1 HP before rolling, ignoring resistance; you must remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Life resistance reduces HP restored, to a minimum of 1 where HP is missing, capped by missing HP. A willing creature harmed by healing instead takes the printed HP amount as Life damage, with normal resistance and minimum damage, and gains no beneficial rider. This card does not permit targeting an unwilling creature. No resurrection, wound removal or Grit restoration.

Weak
Restore 3 HP.
Standard
Restore 5 HP.
Strong
Restore 7 HP. If HP was restored, the recipient also gains 1 Boon to its next spell roll before the end of its next turn.

The Boon modifies an ordinary spell roll, not the spell’s HP cost or an inventory check. Repeated applications replace the unused benefit rather than multiply it.

Additional rulings

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
